integrity: The all-positive-step proof is algebraic with exact local derivative criteria; a standalone symbolic script provides finite supplementary checks only. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only prime period-two cycles and fixed points are enumerated; higher periods and basin sizes are not addressed.
Local attraction relies on a chosen regular implicit successor branch and does not imply global uniqueness or solver-selection guarantees.
Historical priority needs independent checking, especially general spurious-solution papers.
title: Exact six-attractor threshold and complete two-cycle census for cubic implicit Euler
